args.body: At or after the verified November 20 17:00 UTC cutoff, reuse or record and read the welfare release verdict. With the current five unclassified sources, report that the eligible-request threshold was not evidenced and demand remains inconclusive unless new attributable evidence resolves coverage. Record delivery, order acceptance and Treasury settlement separately. Preserve December 4 retirement.

description: Treasury has CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available, but zero classified reports and five unclassified sources leave demand unknown.
